title: Jazz's worldwide reach and the Bechet and Charlie Parker festival story
summary: He tells of a Paris festival where Bechet's set preceded Parker and comments on bop and style.

story.theme_name: Charlie Parker, Dizzy and the bebop revolution
story.community_name: Charlie Parker: encounters, lore and legacy

blocks.x: It's amazing, I think, for us, especially those of us who have not traveled extensively, it's hard for us to realize that jazz has made this tremendous inroad. And it's gone into every country.
